```js
import MockDate from 'mockdate'
import dayjs from '../../src'
import utc from '../../src/plugin/utc'
import timezone from '../../src/plugin/timezone'

dayjs.extend(utc)
dayjs.extend(timezone)

beforeEach(() => { MockDate.set(new Date()) })
afterEach(() => { MockDate.reset() })

const NY = 'America/New_York'

it('parse timestamp, js Date, Day.js object', () => {
  const ts = 1401638400000 // 2014-06-01T12:00:00Z
  const fromTs = dayjs.tz(ts, NY)
  const fromDate = dayjs.tz(new Date(ts), NY)
  const fromDayjs = dayjs.tz(dayjs(ts), NY)
  console.log('fromTs    ', fromTs.format(), fromTs.valueOf(), fromTs.utcOffset())
  console.log('fromDate  ', fromDate.format(), fromDate.valueOf(), fromDate.utcOffset())
  console.log('fromDayjs ', fromDayjs.format(), fromDayjs.valueOf(), fromDayjs.utcOffset())
  console.log('expected  ', '2014-06-01T08:00:00-04:00', 1401638400000, -240)
  expect(fromTs.format()).toBe('2014-06-01T08:00:00-04:00')
  expect(fromDate.format()).toBe('2014-06-01T08:00:00-04:00')
  expect(fromDayjs.format()).toBe('2014-06-01T08:00:00-04:00')
  expect(fromTs.valueOf()).toBe(1401638400000)
  expect(fromDate.valueOf()).toBe(1401638400000)
  expect(fromDayjs.valueOf()).toBe(1401638400000)
})
```

GOAL: empirically characterize the behaviour of the timezone plugin's `format('Z')` / `format('ZZ')` / `utcOffset()` for conversions, to find malformed output.

STEP 1: create a TEMPORARY file /dayjs/test/plugin/__tmp_z.test.js with exactly this content:

```js
import MockDate from 'mockdate'
import dayjs from '../../src'
import utc from '../../src/plugin/utc'
import timezone from '../../src/plugin/timezone'

dayjs.extend(utc)
dayjs.extend(timezone)

beforeEach(() => { MockDate.set(new Date()) })
afterEach(() => { MockDate.reset() })

const NY = 'America/New_York'
const LA = 'America/Los_Angeles'

it('probe Z', () => {
  const show = (name, ins) => {
    console.log(name, '| format:', ins.format(), '| Z:', ins.format('Z'), '| ZZ:', ins.format('ZZ'), '| utcOffset:', ins.utcOffset(), '| valueOf:', ins.valueOf())
  }
  show('dayjs() -> tz(LA)', dayjs().tz(LA))
  show('dayjs(now ms) -> tz(LA)', dayjs(new Date()).tz(LA))
  show('dayjs(2014-06-01T12:00:00Z) -> tz(LA)', dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00Z').tz(LA))
  show('dayjs(2014-06-01T12:00:00.123Z) -> tz(LA)', dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00.123Z').tz(LA))
  show('dayjs(2014-06-01T12:00:00.999Z) -> tz(LA)', dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00.999Z').tz(LA))
  show('dayjs.tz(2014-06-01 12:00, NY)', dayjs.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY))
  show('dayjs.tz(2014-06-01 12:00:00.123, NY)', dayjs.tz('2014-06-01 12:00:00.123', NY))
  show('dayjs.tz(1401638400000, NY)', dayjs.tz(1401638400000, NY))
  show('dayjs(1401638400000).tz(NY)', dayjs(1401638400000).tz(NY))
  show('dayjs.utc(2014-06-01T12:00:00Z).tz(NY)', dayjs.utc('2014-06-01T12:00:00Z').tz(NY))
  show('dayjs(2014-06-01T12:00:00Z).tz(UTC)', dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00Z').tz('UTC'))
  show('dayjs(2014-06-01T12:00:00Z).tz(Europe/London)', dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00Z').tz('Europe/London'))
  show('dayjs(2014-01-01T12:00:00Z).tz(Europe/London)', dayjs('2014-01-01T12:00:00Z').tz('Europe/London'))
  show('dayjs(2014-06-01T12:00:00.123Z).tz(NY)', dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00.123Z').tz(NY))
})
```

```js

  const a = dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00.123Z')
  const target = a.toDate().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: LA })
  const diff = (a.toDate() - new Date(target)) / 1000 / 60
  console.log('target=', target, 'diff=', diff, 'localUtcOffset-diff=', a.utcOffset() - diff)
  const ins = dayjs(target).utcOffset(a.utcOffset() - diff, true)
```
